edges.reason: transfer forwards msg.sender as the sender of the token movement.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as spender when reducing the allowance.
_transfer authorizes the caller against uniswapV2Router and uniswapV2Pair using _msgSender().
manualswap requires _msgSender() to equal _teamAddress.
manualsend requires _msgSender() to equal _teamAddress.
The constructor assigns _owner from _msgSender().
cooldown entries are written from block.timestamp, creating timestamp dependency.
_transfer compares block.timestamp with the stored cooldown value.
openTrading passes block.timestamp as the Uniswap deadline.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the swap deadline.
recipient parameter flows into transfer.
amount parameter flows into transfer.
sender parameter flows into transferFrom.
recipient parameter flows into transferFrom.
amount parameter flows into transferFrom.
spender parameter flows into approve.
amount parameter flows into approve.
from parameter drives the source balance update.
to parameter drives the destination balance update.
amount parameter is validated and transferred.
tokenAmount is approved and passed to the router swap.
amount is split and forwarded to the two fee wallets.
bots_ array entries are written into the bots mapping.
maxTxPercent is used to recompute _maxTxAmount.
onoff flag is written into cooldownEnabled.
contractTokenBalance is passed to swapTokensForEth.
takeFee decides whether fees are removed before _transferStandard.
contractETHBalance is forwarded to sendETHToFee.
path array is supplied to the router swap call.
The local router instance is stored into uniswapV2Router.
currentRate is the value returned by _getRate().
tFee local is computed inside _getTValues.
tTeam local is computed inside _getTValues.
transfer calls _transfer.
transferFrom calls _transfer before adjusting the allowance.
transferFrom updates the allowance through _approve.
_transfer triggers an automatic token-to-ETH swap when conditions allow.
_transfer sends accumulated ETH to the fee wallets.
_transfer ends by invoking _tokenTransfer.
swapTokensForEth performs an external router swap that transfers control out of the contract.
sendETHToFee pushes ETH to external wallets, allowing them to execute code.
openTrading calls the router addLiquidityETH.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee.
setBots writes blacklist flags into the bots mapping.
setCooldownEnabled writes the cooldownEnabled flag.
setMaxTxPercent writes the _maxTxAmount state variable.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to the zero address.
_reflectFee subtracts the fee from _rTotal, an unchecked-math sensitive update.
_transferStandard applies add/sub on _rOwned entries using SafeMath.
_takeTeam adds rTeam to the contract reflection balance.
_getTValues performs mul/div/sub fee arithmetic.
_getRValues performs mul/sub reflection arithmetic.
_getRate divides reflection supply by token supply, dividing by _tTotal.
_teamAddress receives half of the distributed ETH.
_marketingFunds receives half of the distributed ETH.
uniswapV2Router is the target of the swap external call.
uniswapV2Router is the target of the addLiquidityETH call.
_transfer enforces the _maxTxAmount limit.
_transfer reads the bots mapping to block blacklisted addresses.
The router swap can re-enter the contract through receive()/fallback while state is being updated.
ETH push transfers can re-enter sendETHToFee via the receive function.
addLiquidityETH returns control to openTrading before it finalizes flags.
_transfer indirectly reaches the external router swap on the same call frame.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee.
_getValues calls _getTValues.
_getValues calls _getRValues.
_getRate calls _getCurrentSupply to obtain the current supplies.

normalization_plan.reason: recipient parameter has no independent identity outside the transfer function; fold it into the transfer node.
amount parameter is only meaningful as the input of transfer; fold it into the transfer node.
sender parameter only exists within transferFrom; fold it into the transferFrom node.
recipient parameter only exists within transferFrom; fold it into the transferFrom node.
amount parameter only exists within transferFrom; fold it into the transferFrom node.
spender parameter is solely the input of approve; fold it into the approve node.
amount parameter is solely the input of approve; fold it into the approve node.
from parameter is consumed only by _transfer; fold it into the _transfer node.
to parameter is consumed only by _transfer; fold it into the _transfer node.
amount parameter is consumed only by _transfer; fold it into the _transfer node.
tokenAmount parameter feeds the swap performed by swapTokensForEth; fold it into that function node.
amount parameter is split between the fee wallets inside sendETHToFee; fold it into that function node.
bots_ array is iterated and written by setBots; fold it into the setBots node.
maxTxPercent only defines the new _maxTxAmount in setMaxTxPercent; fold it into that function node.
onoff boolean only toggles cooldownEnabled in setCooldownEnabled; fold it into that function node.
contractTokenBalance is a transient local in _transfer; fold it into the _transfer node.
takeFee is a transient local that drives fee removal in _tokenTransfer; fold it into that function node.
contractETHBalance is the transient ETH balance passed to sendETHToFee; fold it into that function node.
path array is a transient swap argument inside swapTokensForEth; fold it into that function node.
The local router instance is created and stored inside openTrading; fold it into the openTrading node.
currentRate local is the computed return value of _getRate; fold it into the _getRate node.
tFee local is a transient fee value computed in _getTValues; fold it into that function node.
tTeam local is a transient team fee value computed in _getTValues; fold it into that function node.
